mentions.name: ColorHunt
mentions.description: This game assigns players a random colour and gives them 24 hours to go out and take photos matching it, then generates a photo grid from everything captured. It offers a solo mode (9 photos), a 1v1 mode competing against a friend with a combined grid, and a squad mode where everyone contributes to a 20-photo grid; newer palette (3 colours) and rainbow (9 colours) modes and squad rooms with breaks, photo reactions, and spectating are included. It requires no accounts, app installs, or personal data storage, and photos and generated grids auto-delete from Cloudflare R2 after 24 hours.

mentions.name: Colorhunt
mentions.description: A browser-based photo scavenger hunt game where each player is assigned a random colour and has 24 hours to go out and take photos matching it, after which the game generates a photo grid from everything captured. Supports Solo (9 photos by yourself), 1v1 (compete against a friend with a combined grid) and Squad (everyone contributes to a 20-photo grid) modes. Requires no accounts, no app install, and stores no personal data; photos and generated grids auto-delete after 24 hours from Cloudflare R2 storage.
